sources.entry: Open Archiver - Email archiving solution with full-text search and eDiscovery search features. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Open Archiver is a self-hosted, open-source email archiving platform that ingests mail from Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP, PST and mbox sources and makes it searchable with full-text and eDiscovery tools.
summary.what_it_does: Open Archiver connects to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, generic IMAP inboxes, and imports from PST, zipped .eml and mbox files, with continuous sync after the initial bulk import. Emails are stored in standard .eml format with deduplication, compression, and encryption at rest, on either local filesystem or S3-compatible object storage. A search engine indexes email bodies and attachments such as PDF and DOCX for full-text search with filters. It also offers thread discovery, granular retention policies, and legal holds (marked TBD in the README). File hashes are stored at ingestion so altered files can be detected, with an "Integrity Report" per email, and an immutable audit trail logs system activity. The stack is SvelteKit frontend, Node.js/Express/TypeScript backend, BullMQ on Redis (Valkey in Compose), Meilisearch, and PostgreSQL.
use_cases: search across old emails and attachments
ediscovery and legal hold for email
import PST or mbox archives into one place
how_to_run: git clone the OpenArchiver repository and cd into it
cp .env.example .env and edit admin passwords and secret keys
docker compose up -d to pull images and start all services
Open the web interface in a browser and configure an ingestion source (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or generic IMAP)
notable: Ingests from Gmail, Microsoft 365, generic IMAP, PST, zipped .eml and mbox files with ongoing sync
Per-email Integrity Report based on stored file hashes to detect alterations
Emails stored as standard .eml with deduplication, compression and encryption at rest
Pluggable storage: local filesystem or S3-compatible object storage
Immutable audit trail of system activity
caveats: Requires at least 4GB RAM (2GB with external Postgres, Redis/Valkey and Meilisearch)
Legal hold feature is marked TBD in the README
Deployment is documented only via Docker Compose
